item.title: Free disaster kits handed out to Tampa residents ahead of 2026 hurricane season
item.description: It’s early to be thinking about disaster preparedness, but many communities are still rebuilding after Milton and Helene in 2024. A nonprofit helped make sure Tampa residents jumpstart their readiness with free kits.Volunteers bagged up 500 disaster kits stuffed with flashlights, fireproof bags, solar-powered battery packs, dry bags and more.
